auth.new_ssm_disclaimer_summary: Applicant registration is carried out within the period established by the Minister's individual administrative-legal act. After this period expires, it is prohibited to make changes in the registration system.
auth.new_ssm_disclaimer_content: For the purpose of enrolling persons with special educational needs in the program, psycho-educational assessment and consultation specialists ensure the assessment of applicants registered with special educational needs status, preparation of assessment conclusions, and placement of conclusions in the registration system no later than 5 working days from registration, which confirms the applicant's special educational needs.
auth.new_ssm_disclaimer_final_selection: In case a person with special educational needs is registered for several vocational educational programs, taking into account the selection results, within the period established by the Minister's individual administrative-legal act, they must make a final choice and select one of the vocational educational programs indicated during registration for which they obtained the right to enroll in the registration system. After which, they submit the documents required by the institution for enrollment in the mentioned program to the institution.
auth.new_general_disclaimer_summary: Applicant registration is carried out within the period established by the Minister's individual administrative-legal act. After this period expires, it is prohibited to make changes in the registration system.
auth.new_general_disclaimer_content: For detailed information about selection procedures and methods organized by institutions, please contact the institution.
auth.new_general_disclaimer_final_selection: If an applicant has selected several programs during registration, after the availability of selection results, within the period established by the Minister's individual administrative-legal act, they select one of the programs indicated during registration for which they obtained the right to enroll in the registration system. After this, they submit the documents required by the institution for enrollment in the mentioned program to the institution.
auth.terms_and_conditions_intro: We inform you that on the registration website for vocational education candidates (vet.emis.ge), for the purposes of your registration for relevant programs, your personal data will be processed in accordance with the Law of Georgia 'On Personal Data Protection'.
auth.personal_data_contact: Applicant's phone number and email address
auth.personal_data_education: Information about the applicant's achieved level of education
auth.processing_purposes_title: For what purposes do we process your data:
auth.processing_purpose_identification: For the purpose of your identification during the registration stage
auth.processing_purpose_citizenship: For the purpose of verifying citizenship status
auth.processing_purpose_status: For the purpose of establishing/verifying the existence of other status defined by legislation
auth.processing_purpose_admission: For the purpose of maintaining admission prerequisites for the relevant program
auth.special_data_educational_needs: Status of a person with special educational needs
auth.special_data_refugee: Asylum seeker, refugee or humanitarian status
auth.special_data_purposes_title: For what purposes may your special category data be processed:
auth.special_purpose_disability: Special category data is processed for the purpose of implementing the right to education for persons with disabilities and persons with special educational needs
auth.special_purpose_migration: Special category data is processed for the purpose of functioning of the unified analytical system of migration data
auth.special_purpose_legal: Processing of special category data is directly and specifically regulated by law and their processing is a necessary and proportionate measure in a democratic society
auth.data_sources_title: Where do we obtain your data from:
auth.data_source_registration: By entering data on vet.emis.ge during registration for vocational education programs
auth.data_source_state_services: From the LEPL - State Services Development Agency operating within the Ministry of Justice of Georgia
auth.data_source_social_services: From the LEPL - Social Services Agency
auth.data_source_education_systems: The management system verifies information about the applicant's achieved level of education in the information systems for general, vocational and higher education management, in case of existence of data about the applicant
auth.legal_basis_title: On what grounds do we process your data:
auth.legal_basis_text: The processing of your personal data by us is provided for by the legislation of Georgia - the Law of Georgia 'On Personal Data Protection', Order No. 42/N of July 2, 2021 of the Minister of Education and Science of Georgia 'On Approval of the Rules and Conditions for Enrollment in Vocational Educational Programs'.
auth.read_and_understand_rules: I agree and declare that I have read the above information on personal data processing

non_formal.seekerRightsAndResponsibilities: The seeker has the right to demand quality service, to be informed about activities related to the proceedings, and to get acquainted with the documents created within the scope of the proceedings. Failure to attend a consultation meeting 3 times without prior notification from the seeker or refusal to participate is grounds for termination of the initiated proceedings.
non_formal.evidenceAndConsultationInfo: The evidence collection and consultation stage will be conducted remotely, and if the recognition commission decides to hold an exam, the assessment will be carried out in person at the college address. The costs are determined individually for each seeker, according to their needs, taking into account the specifics of the exam, the depreciation of material resources, and the cost of raw materials. If the seeker organizes an observation/exam at their workplace, the fee will be calculated by deducting the cost of depreciation of the relevant material resources/raw materials.
